compiled_state.title: Create coherence-walk.sh: multi-opus coherence gate for planning artifacts
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Task

Create `plugins/dso/scripts/coherence-walk.sh` — a shell script that calls the Anthropic API at opus tier to verify consistency between `## Closure Checks` and `## Success Criteria` sections in planning ticket artifacts.

## Approach
Follow the pattern established by `enrich-file-impact.sh`:
- Use `resolve-model-id.sh opus` for model resolution
- Call `api.anthropic.com/v1/messages` via `curl` with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
- Gracefully degrade (exit 0, emit WARNING) when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` absent
- Support `--dry-run` flag

## Interface
```
coherence-walk.sh [--dry-run] [ticket-id ...]
```
- No ticket IDs → scan all open epics/stories via ticket CLI
- With IDs → analyze only those tickets

## Output Format (DD2)
Per-artifact line: `PASS: <id>`, `FAIL <id>: <reason>`, or `AMBIGUOUS <id>: <reason>`
Aggregate summary: `COHERENCE_SUMMARY: N/M artifacts PASS`

## FAIL/AMBIGUOUS Re-entry (DD4)
Each FAIL/AMBIGUOUS result must include:
```
NEXT_STEP: create bug ticket via: .claude/scripts/dso ticket create bug "Coherence: <id>" ...
```

## Backward Compat
Tickets without `## Closure Checks` section → emit `PASS: <id> (no Closure Checks section — backward compat)`

## Exit Codes
- 0: all artifacts PASS (or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY absent graceful skip)
- 1: at least one FAIL result
- Exits 0 on AMBIGUOUS (non-blocking, recommendations only)

## File Impact
- `plugins/dso/scripts/coherence-walk.sh` — create
- `plugins/dso/scripts/resolve-model-id.sh` — read only (no changes)
